# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-08-06

Last week I launched Whisperly, my macOS dictation app, on Fazier. The listing was paid, $39, and it did great. #1 Product of the Day. #4 Product of the Week. #4 Product of the Month. A "Featured on Fazier" badge showing 108 upvotes. And here's the same launch in PostHog, filtere

Went through 40 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. Fazier #1 badge drove only 19 visits and zero signups for a paid SaaS launch.
   Concrete distribution numbers separate badge vanity from actual user acquisition.

2. Flowise posted a sunset notice, which is a migration signal if you depend on the product.
   Potential shutdown risk changes build-vs-buy and migration decisions.

3. LangChain Anthropic 1.5.4 fixes tool schema handling and preserves caller tool_choice.
   Small release, but directly relevant to agent tool-calling correctness.

4. Reported X spend of $3.5K produced impressions and clicks, but effectively no signups.
   Hard spend plus weak conversion data is useful for paid acquisition decisions.

5. Composio CLI 0.3.2 makes shell setup the installer default and replaces binaries atomically.
   Installer reliability and lower setup friction matter for local automation tools.

Full brief with all 40 researched links → https://thenightlylibrarian.com/briefs/2026-08-06
